description: Byggegrense Jernbane Nordre Follo is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Nordre Follo kommune. 30 meters byggegrense langs jernbanespor. Datasettet er ment som et hjelpemiddel for å kunne synliggjøre og hensynta områder som kan berøres av Jernbanelovens § 10, som definerer en 30 meters byggegrense regnet fra nærmeste spors midtlinje. Coverage: Nordre Follo kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Nordre Follo kommune. Its keywords include Plan, fellesDatakatalog, Nordre Follo kommune, Det offentlige kartgrunnlaget. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2023-10-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
